What this means for Guardian Insurance

  1. 1Price by pattern, not by a flat rush-hour rule — the heatmap shows the 7–8 AM / 4–5 PM peaks are a weekday phenomenon; weekend risk is flatter and shifts later.
  2. 2Score cities on severity, not just claim volume — high-count cities like Charlotte don't carry the highest average severity; Dallas and Los Angeles do, despite lower volume.
  3. 3The dataset has no Speed / Speed Limit field — Distance(mi) is used here as an indirect proxy and should not substitute for real telematics speed data in pricing models.
  4. 4Fall and Winter carry higher volume — worth testing as a seasonal premium or campaign factor alongside state and time-of-day.
